what: Plan requires a stat failure stub but does not specify write_stub_stat or wire it into the harness
scenario_or_breakage: Current harness only writes claude gh and rm stubs; the proposed stat-fallback-mtime-zero case cannot deliberately fail both stat -f '%m' -- <path> and stat -c '%Y' -- <path> for one cache dir while allowing unrelated stat calls through
suggested_fix: Add a concrete write_stub_stat helper, call it from run_case, pass STAT_FAIL_VERSION or similar through the SCRIPT environment, and have the stub inspect the final target argument, fail only for that version, and exec a captured real stat binary for all other invocations
